objective_for_doctor:
Age: 78
Sex: M
Chief Complaint: symptoms worse when lying down and alleviated while sitting up

turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?
My symptoms are worse when lying down and get better when I’m sitting up. I also have a cough and pain in my upper chest/epigastric area, with the pain intensity about 6 out of 10.
[ASK] Do you have chest pain or pressure that is worse with exertion and/or relieved by rest?
[ASK] Are you currently having chest pain/pressure that is new, worsening, or occurring at rest (not your usual pattern) within the last 24–48 hours?
